name: P. gingivalis WW2842, as originally scored
reference: Reproduces the original script exactly, including a seven base spacer for all four families, no pyrimidine constraint on the N2 half site, and an N1C2 reverse motif of TAA{spacer}TCA. That reverse motif is not the reverse complement of the N1C2 forward motif; it is kept here only so published counts can be reproduced. Use the ww2842 preset for new work.
